name: Sinnamon
source:
Sinnamon or Sinna, is the younger cousin of Parfait introduced in Cinderella Phenomenon: Evermore. Depending on the route, he is either currently in training to become the next Lucis Bearer or already is the next Lucis Bearer.

[Taken from Cinderella Phenomenon wiki]
